name: cloud-nine-planner
description: Cloud Nine: a soft, pastel life planner for study, habits, calendars, news and an AI helper. Runs in any browser, installs on Windows and iPhone.

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/store.js && node --check src/ai.js && node --check public/app.js

APP_PASSCODE.description: The passcode you will type to open Cloud Nine. Pick something only you know, at least 8 characters.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. A free Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey for the AI helper. You can also paste it later inside the app's Settings. Leave as 'none' to skip.
